camps.description: Garden State Council wooded camping facility in Camden County, NJ (about 20 minutes east of Philadelphia). Serves as one of four South Jersey locations for the 2026 Camp Roar-A-Saurus Cub Scout day camp program (Mon-Fri 8:30am-4pm). Offers shooting sports, canoeing, fishing, hiking trails, and a large field pavilion.

camps.description: Garden State Council camp in the Pinelands National Reserve, Tabernacle, NJ. One of four South Jersey locations for the 2026 Camp Roar-A-Saurus Cub Scout day camp (Mon-Fri 8:30am-4pm), with programs in canoeing, BB gun and archery, orienteering, and trail biking. Facilities include six heated cabins and a conference center.
